name: Conformance: v2 tableStorage schema probe
description: Fixture for `v2-table-schema-enforcement.test.ts` (spec/v2/core/storage.md §`tableStorage`: rows MUST conform to the table's declared schema). One node, `core.conformance.table-schema-probe` (conformance-RESERVED): a host that advertises `tableStorage` maps it to a node that calls its OWN `ctx.storage.table` for the run's tenant with the run's inputs and nothing else. Every action first calls `createTable(table, { k: "string", n: "number" })`. `action: control` then inserts `{ k: "control", n: 1 }` and completes with `outputs.result = { inserted: true, rowId }`. `action: insert-mistyped` inserts `{ k: "mistyped", n: "not-a-number" }`; if the host accepts it the node completes with `{ inserted: true, rowId }`. `action: update-mistyped` inserts `{ k: "to-update", n: 2 }`, then calls `update(table, rowId, { n: "not-a-number" })`; if the host accepts it the node completes with `{ updated: true, rowId }`. The node does no type checking of its own. A rejection fails the node with the rejection's code and details, unchanged. A host that does not advertise `tableStorage` MUST NOT advertise this fixture.
